PollingStation 1 -- * PollInElectionA PollInElection has A PollingStation. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one PollingStation.A PollingStation has some PollInElections. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When a PollInElection is created, its PollingStation must be assigned. When a PollInElection is deleted, its PollingStation is not deleted and its list of PollInElections is decreased. When a PollingStation is deleted, its PollInElections are not deleted. They are assigned to another PollingStation.
